title: Open Certification Training Project Topic Questions
description: A nonempty array of questions about the topic named by the JSON file.

questionType.description: Optional question format. Applications treat an omitted type as multiple-choice. True-false questions have exactly two option strings and exactly one correct answer index.

questionText.description: Complete question wording. Maps to Question.text in JSON-LD.

answerOptions.description: Unique answer strings in display order. Each option is identified by its zero-based array index and maps to an Answer in suggestedAnswer.

correctAnswers.description: A zero-based option index for one correct answer, or an array of unique indexes. A one-element array is also allowed. Resolve indexes to answerOptions when generating acceptedAnswer.
correctAnswers.$comment: Application validation must check that every index is less than answerOptions.length. Reordering options requires updating their answer indexes.

explanation.description: Explanation of why the identified answers are correct.

answerIndex.description: Zero-based position in answerOptions: 0 refers to the first option.
